Class CSVTableDataWriter

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.query.report.csv.CSVTableDataWriter
public class CSVTableDataWriter extends Object
Writes a csv file based on the values displayed in a given JTable. Note, this only outputs the displayed values, not the entire table model.
